structure_notes: The source is hands-only throughout; no face or talking-head presenter appears.
The edit moves from raw rice to cooked rice, then to packaging proof, back to food texture, and ends on the package.
The adaptation preserves all thirteen source shot windows while replacing unsupported origin, process, aroma and texture claims.
One warm wood table is the hard background identity; close-ups may use stronger bokeh and tighter crop.
No source-derived frame may be used as an ImageGen or H3 reference.

beats.visual_action: Raw grains hard-cut to a rice-cooker reveal, a cooked-rice close-up and two hands lifting uncooked grains.
beats.visual_sync: The counter-intuitive opening rides the immediate raw-to-cooked contrast.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 千万别吃东北大米，我怕你吃过一次啊，别的大米就再吃不下去了，特别是这个东北五常大米。

beats.visual_action: Chopsticks lift cooked rice, a hand presents a small bowl, then the retail pack appears upright.
beats.visual_sync: The package arrives only after two cooked-rice result shots.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 它真是太香了，就算没有菜也能吃上好几碗。这一箱是十斤装。

beats.visual_action: Three brisk packaging views move from abundance to visible grains and a complete front-label view.
beats.visual_sync: The central package sequence replaces unsupported source pack-count and origin claims with visible target-pack facts.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 里面有五小袋，都是真空包装的，东北黑土地种植，一年只产这一季。

beats.visual_action: Grains fall into a shallow rattan tray before both hands lift them for a close tactile view.
beats.visual_sync: One continuous macro shot carries the evidence while unsupported production claims are removed.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 不抛光不打蜡，油汪汪亮晶晶的，颗粒饱满，软糯劲道。

beats.visual_action: A cooked-rice chopstick macro hard-cuts to the complete retail pack for the final hold.
beats.visual_sync: The call to action lands on the clean front-pack finish.
beats.ref_text_corrected: 米香浓郁，自己吃，过年过节送人都很不错。
